🔥Building Our Agentic OS, Skill Packs, & More Updates🔥
This week is the biggest update to the Chase AI+ Claude Code Masterclass yet!
We now learn how to build (and sell) a full Agentic OS-- think a Claude Code powered OpenClaw that is cheaper, more effective, and more customizable than its lobster counterpart.
I also launched a brand new Masterclass section: Skill Packs.
These are the exact Claude Code skills I use daily for research and content creation, now broken down and available for you to plug into your own setup. Several more skill packs are in... See more

The Agentic OS angle is really interesting. I have been running something similar with Claude Code managing a team of specialized agents for my voice AI agency. Each agent handles a different function (content, outreach, research, client ops) and they coordinate through a shared task queue. The skill packs idea is smart because that modularity is what makes the whole system work. Curious how you are handling state and memory between agent runs. That has been my biggest challenge at scale.
